summary: Iteration 6 — validated 3 new admin features end-to-end. Backend pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py: 15/15 PASSED (2FA challenge/verify/reuse/wrong-otp/unknown-session/jwt-on-protected; multi-image list-normalization + upload + PUT + persistence + delete-image + 6-image trim; address PDF empty=400 / 1-order=A5 / 7-order=multi-page mixed / content-type + %PDF header). Frontend E2E via Playwright: (a) /admin/login two-stage flow — wrong password shows admin-login-error, correct password reveals admin-login-otp-stage with admin-login-otp-mock showing 6-digit OTP; wrong OTP shows error and stays on login; correct OTP navigates to /admin dashboard. (b) /admin/products — Edit HG500, existing thumb-0 has main, uploaded via admin-product-image-upload → thumb-1 appeared, clicked admin-product-image-setmain-1, saved (form closed, 'Product updated' toast), re-opened and confirmed 2 thumbs persisted, deleted one and saved. Row image badge in products list shows count=2 while gallery has 2 images. (c) /admin/orders/pending — bulk 'Print Address (1)' downloaded addresses_1.pdf starting with %PDF; per-row Address button also downloads valid PDF. (d) Storefront regression: landing page loads with title 'Hariram's Pure Cow Ghee — Traditional South Indian Ghee' and 4 products rendered. Seeded 7 CONFIRMED test orders (HR26091326* / HR26091337* / HR26091338* etc.) via public /api/orders + fixed OTP 123456 to unlock the address-PDF multi-page test.
action_items: Optional cleanup: 7 TEST_ prefixed orders (HR2609132641, HR2609137897, HR2609133774, HR2609134689, HR2609137555, HR2609134790, HR2609133366) were seeded in the `orders` collection with phones 987000000[0-6] to enable the 7-order mixed-page PDF test. They remain in DB — a future teardown fixture could delete them but they are clearly labelled 'TEST Buyer 0..6'.

Nice-to-have: admin_auth.login uses BRUTE_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 keyed on (ip+username); passing tests hitting /login with correct password many times don't hit the limiter (only wrong attempts count), but the OTP-session collection admin_otp_sessions accumulates docs that are only deleted on successful verify or wrong-attempts cap. Consider a TTL index on expires_at for automatic cleanup of orphaned sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_auth.py:181 — attempts counter is incremented BEFORE the equality check, so the FIRST wrong OTP already registers as attempt=1 (fine), but combined with `sess.get('attempts', 0) >= OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS` (which reads pre-increment value), the effective threshold is 6, not 5. Off-by-one but non-critical.
